nsg-rule controller NSG: tcp/8080 from 10.251.0.128/26 (load balancer to ts-auth)

cloudflare: SSL Full (strict) for gru.api.terrascale.tech and gru.auth.terrascale.tech, custom zone Authenticated Origin Pulls on; requires public_api.origin_pull CA and certificate ID (oci-region dns)

declaration_hash_rule: Exact complete raw declaration from manually reviewed func line through column-zero close, excluding following LF. Evidence spans likewise exclude final LF. No source parser or bound discovery.

classification_definitions.integration: Real project service/API/network/process/store/runtime boundary materially supports the asserted observable behavior. Local simulation qualifies only for the real boundary it actually reaches.
classification_definitions.unit: Local value/schema/predicate/formatter or pre-I/O guard assertions; incidental fixture file setup or merely constructing a server is not sufficient.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent unit-only assertion block(s) alongside real boundary-backed assertion block(s).
classification_definitions.unresolved: Insufficient mapping/source/boundary evidence to assign a category. Uncredited assertion blockers are retained separately even when root category is known.

fixture_limits: fakeOCI is not mock-only: sdkFixture starts httptest.NewTLSServer and redirects TLS dialing to it. Production SDK clients sign requests; the simulator checks a Signature header prefix, not cryptographic authorization. It is not live OCI, IAM admission, or instance-principal qualification.
